spec_match.rationale: Preview uses native setHTML(raw) with the default sanitizer, but the code sample shows the removed allowElements/allowAttributes/dropAttributes config vocabulary, and the unused `new Sanitizer()` instance is never passed.

interactive.rationale: Six snippets, typing, and Clear drive a live preview; the B/I/code/link/quote toolbar inserts rich formatting via execCommand, but the preview reads innerText, so formatting vanishes (B → preview 'text', no <b>).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Promises a threat log tracking every removed element; the log renders removed tags as real elements, so element names are missing.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers script/onerror/javascript:/iframe/data: snippets, but the data: uri snippet is malformed (an alt="" was injected inside the attribute value) and the threat finder only checks on* and javascript: (style, svg, form etc. are only inferred from tag-set diff).

references.rationale: Its only ChromeStatus link is chromestatus.com/feature/5786893650231296 — the OLD, unshipped Sanitizer entry — not 5814067399491584; no spec link.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 driven by Node Playwright (chromium.launch) against a local server on :3111 — NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP-verified evidence; no accessibility-tree dump was taken. openQuestions.title: Render the threat log with textContent
openQuestions.detail: Repro: click 'iframe embed' → threat row reads 'element removed' and an empty iframe is inserted into #threat-list; 'script tag' inserts a <script>. findThreats details like `<${tag}> removed` go through innerHTML. Build rows via DOM/textContent.

openQuestions.title: Point the references at feature 5814067399491584
openQuestions.detail: The only ChromeStatus link is the unshipped 2021 entry 5786893650231296; the self-heal invariant requires this feature's id. Add the spec link.

openQuestions.title: Fix the toolbar or switch the editor to a plain textarea
openQuestions.detail: Repro: Clear, click B → editor shows bold 'text', preview shows plain 'text'. Either insert literal tag text (setRangeText on a textarea) or read editor.innerHTML.

openQuestions.title: Update the code sample to the shipped config shape and repair the data: snippet
Add a sanitize-on-paste angle
openQuestions.detail: Reading text/html from a paste/drop event and inserting with setHTML (or Document.parseHTML then moving nodes, per guidance on avoiding mXSS) is the most common real-world entry point and not covered.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use setHTML()/Document.parseHTML() with a Sanitizer config of the current shape (elements, attributes, replaceWithChildrenElements); elements not in `elements` are removed with their content; unsafe elements cannot be re-allowed via setHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Partly followed — preview uses setHTML; code sample uses superseded config vocabulary.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never interpolate user-controlled strings into innerHTML; use textContent or DOM construction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — threat log interpolates tag names into innerHTML, instantiating removed elements.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous/changing results through a polite live region (role=status/log or aria-live) and keep controls as native buttons with accessible names.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Partly followed — 0px overflow, but tap targets under 44px.

summary: The preview is genuine setHTML, but the surrounding demo is buggy: the threat log instantiates the very elements it reports as removed, the toolbar's formatting never reaches the preview, the code sample uses obsolete config names, and the page cites the wrong (unshipped) ChromeStatus feature.
